name: Boggle Sight Stealer

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

sourceBooks: Monster Vault: Threats to the Nentir Vale
description: Small creatures occupy the same space as Medium creatures, but they face some restrictions in the weapons they can wield: • You can’t use two-handed weapons, such as greatswords and halberds. • When you use a versatile weapon, such as a longsword, you must use it two-handed, but you don’t deal additional damage for doing so.

traits.name: Dimensional Window
traits.details: The boggle can make Thievery checks against any creature within 10 squares of it that it is aware of.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature grabbed by the boggle

powers.name: Peek-a-Boo Trick
powers.requirements: The boggle must have no creature grabbed.

hit.description: The boggle teleports the target to an unoccupied square within 2 squares of the boggle, and the target is grabbed (escape DC 13). The target is blinded until the grab ends. The boggle must remain within 2 squares of the target for the grab to persist.

effect.description: The boggle teleports up to 3 squares.

powers.name: Face Rip
powers.trigger: A creature grabbed by the boggle escapes the grab.

effect.description: Melee 2 (triggering creature). The target takes 1d8 + 5 damage, and the boggle teleports up to 3 squares.
